cli.help:
FalconCut — MCP server for Adobe Premiere Pro

Usage:
  falconcut-mcp                 Start the MCP server (stdio)
  falconcut-mcp --install-cep   Install the FalconCut panel and configure MCP clients
  falconcut-mcp --doctor        Check the server build, the FalconCut panel and client settings
  falconcut-mcp --version       Print the installed version
  falconcut-mcp --help          Show this help

Environment variables:
  FALCONCUT_LANG=kk|en          Language of messages (default: kk)
  FALCONCUT_BRIDGE_DIR=<path>   Temp folder shared with the Premiere panel
  FALCONCUT_TOOLSET=full        List every Premiere tool to the MCP client at once

FalconCut sends no telemetry and makes no network requests.
